about_the_game:
Bring forgotten places back to life!

Welcome to a bright and cozy world where every dirty surface can shine again, and every neglected place can become beautiful and inviting. Restore locations, clean up years of mess, repair damaged areas, and watch the world transform through your hard work.

Take your time, enjoy the relaxing atmosphere, and experience the satisfaction of bringing every location back to life.

Restore every detail

Each location has its own unique atmosphere, distinct challenges, and countless details waiting for your attention. Explore the environment, remove dirt and debris, repair damaged objects, and restore every place to its former beauty.

With every task you complete, the world becomes cleaner, cozier, and more vibrant.

Use a variety of tools

Every restoration project requires the right equipment. Use 9 different tools, each designed for a specific task.

Wash dirty surfaces, collect trash, repair walls, clean floors, paint, clear overgrown vegetation, and complete a wide range of restoration tasks as you gradually transform the environment.

Decorate your way

Cleaning is only the beginning.

Once a location has been restored, you can decorate it with furniture and decorative items. Place everything exactly where you want and create a unique layout that reflects your personal style.

Furniture is limited, making every decorating decision meaningful while giving each player the freedom to create something truly their own.

Relax and enjoy the atmosphere

There are no enemies, no timers, and no pressure.

Simply enjoy the satisfying cleaning gameplay, immerse yourself in the colorful stylized visuals, unwind with the relaxing atmosphere, and experience the joy of transforming forgotten places into beautiful, welcoming spaces.
